summary: Quanome Technologies filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing a September 28, 2026 Revolving Loan Agreement with Chairman/CEO Yang Li as lender, providing up to $15.0 million in advances at 6.0% per annum, maturing three months after the effective date. The Audit Committee, comprising three independent directors, approved the related-party transaction, and advances require lender consent. Proceeds fund working capital and general corporate purposes; amounts may be prepaid without penalty. Outstanding balances accelerate if Li ceases serving as both Chairman and CEO. This is a routine credit facility and related-party financing, not a special situation; watch liquidity and related-party governance risk.
